text:
dylan: scan-bot flagged a CRITICAL in `yaml-helpers` during PR checks for #412. GHAS check is failing the PR.

vuln-bot: Trivy/GHAS summary:
```
Package: yaml-helpers@0.3.1
Vuln: CVE-2026-9999 - arbitrary code execution via unsafe load
Severity: CRITICAL
Path: frontend/test-utils -> yaml-helpers
Note: package is listed in devDependencies
```

sarah_w: hmm that package is only used by our test fixture loader. Not bundled in prod. Might be a false positive for runtime exploit surface.

priya_g: GHAS treats any dependency found in the tree the same, so PR check blocks merge. We have repo-level suppressions for Trivy but GHAS doesn't pull those automatically.

mike_ops: bonus issue — scanner pipeline couldn't fetch last scan artifact earlier. Logs show KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied for the scanner role which made the job re-scan everything.

mike_ops: snippet from logs:
```
ERROR: S3 GetObject failed: AccessDenied
cause: KMS Decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd
Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scanner-sa
```

dylan: proposal:
- temporary: add a repo-level suppression entry for `yaml-helpers` scoped to devDependencies and mention why (test-only fixture)
- short-term infra: fix scanner role IAM to allow kms:Decrypt with condition that only allows decrypt for objects tagged with `redwood:scan=true` or encryption-context `scanner-job`
- long-term: replace yaml-helpers with a minimal inline parser or bump upstream if they patch

priya_g: agree on the suppression but let's make the suppression explicit about scope so we don't silence real prod vulns. Example suppression file:
```
# .scans/suppressions.yaml
- package: yaml-helpers
  versions: ["0.3.1"]
  reason: "dev/test fixture only - not shipped in production bundles"
  scope: "devDependency"
  expires: "2026-05-01"
```

sarah_w: +1. Also will add a note in the PR template to call out suppressed CVEs so reviewers know why it's safe.

mike_ops: for the KMS fix, I'm proposing IAM statement like:
```
Effect: Allow
Action: kms:Decrypt
Resource: <scanner-key-arn>
Condition:
  StringEquals:
    kms:EncryptionContext: "scan-job": "true"
Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scanner-sa
```
I'll open an infra PR to add that and test in staging.

dylan: triage guidance for this CVE:
- if dependency is only dev/test and not part of build output -> set priority LOW and suppress with expiry
- if dependency is bundled into any server or client artifact -> HIGH and require immediate patch/lockfile update + rollback if exploit is trivial
- if scanner cannot prove usage (tree ambiguous) -> assign to eng to validate runtime surface (label: needs-runtime-check)

priya_g: I'll file a triage ticket and mark it LOW with the suppression attached. Also will update GHAS workflow to run an extra step that ignores devDependencies for merge gating (until we get artifact-based checks in place).

mike_ops: infra PR created: infra#289 — adds KMS decrypt condition for scanner-sa. Will post test results here once staging runs.

vuln-bot: Note: suppression added in repo .scans/suppressions.yaml by priya_g at 1972010000 (temporary). Auto-scan will re-run.

dylan: thanks. Action items:
- priya_g: add suppression + file triage ticket (due EOD)
- mike_ops: infra PR for KMS fix (monitor staging)
- sarah_w: add PR template note and double-check build pipeline to ensure dev deps are not bundled

sarah_w: assigned and on it. Will update this thread when done.

dylan: leaving final note — if GHAS keeps blocking merges for suppressible test-only stuff, we should consider a small GHAS config change to surface but not fail PRs for dev-only vulns (notify only). We'll discuss in next security sync. :eyes:
